title: Inventory-driven vulnerability identification
objective: Every deployed component, derived from build manifests and SBOMs, is continuously matched against vulnerability sources; components absent from the inventory are detected as gaps rather than silently excluded.
implementing_systems: not yet assigned (candidate: SCA tooling such as OSV-Scanner or Trivy fed by build SBOMs)
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)
residual_risks: Advisory databases lag disclosure; F# and niche NuGet packages may have sparse advisory coverage.

title: Risk-based prioritization with exploitation signals
objective: Findings are prioritized using CVSS v4.0 with environmental metrics, EPSS likelihood and KEV membership, with documented reachability determinations reviewed by someone other than the fixing engineer.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Remediation SLA enforcement and release gate
objective: Open findings past SLA, and any KEV finding in a release candidate, block release unless covered by an unexpired approved exception.
implementing_systems: Praxis (candidate release gate host; not yet configured for this control)
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Time-limited, separately approved vulnerability exceptions
objective: Exceptions are explicit, narrowly scoped, time-limited, approved by an accountable reviewer other than the requester, carry compensating controls and expire automatically; AI agents cannot approve or extend them.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Coordinated vulnerability disclosure intake
objective: A published policy, security.txt and monitored channel receive external reports, which enter the same register and SLA process as internal findings.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Customer vulnerability notification and VEX
objective: Customers are notified of vulnerabilities affecting their tenant or release, and receive VEX statements for components determined not affected.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Rebuild-and-redeploy patching of platform components
objective: Runtime, database engine, base image and OS security updates are applied by rebuilding immutable artifacts and redeploying; deployed versions are continuously compared to the patched baseline and to vendor support windows.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Independent verification of AI-authored fixes
objective: Fixes authored by AI agents require review by a different principal and passing security regression tests; agents cannot modify the gate, the finding status or the exception register.
implementing_systems: Praxis (provenance and work records exist; enforcement for this control not implemented)
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)
